metadata.title: styxx v7.50.0 — the front door says, in EXTERNAL-1's committed words, that the gate claim is not yet true; the diff gate cuts a diff where git does; every diffgate record and charon's verifier name the build and runtime that wrote them
metadata.description:
This version continues the styxx software record (v6.2.0, the reference implementation of the Cognometric Fingerprint Specification v1.0, 10.5281/zenodo.19746215; its deposited foundations outline predates the 2026-06-21 scope note, D5 in zenodo/MANIFEST.json) and belongs to the Fathom research series (10.5281/zenodo.19326174).

styxx v7.50.0, cut 2026-10-22 and released 2026-10-23: a minor release. This record holds the Python package exactly as published on PyPI and the source tree at the git tag v7.50.0 (commit bebdadf1562c742f53f2114cad99b4aba0738cdf). It is a version in the styxx software concept record 10.5281/zenodo.19758618, which resolves to the latest version. styxx 7.49.0, the release before this one, is 10.5281/zenodo.23221755 in the same concept (released 2026-10-07).

The release, in the words of the ## [7.50.0] section's opening paragraph (its last sentence, on the order of its entries, left out): A minor release: the front door prints the sentence the lab's 2026-08-31 preregistration committed it to ("an agent's PR summary cannot lie about its diff" is not yet true of this instrument on real-world data; EXTERNAL-1, precision 0.23) and stops making the claim on every shipped surface, held there by a word lint in CI; the diff gate cuts a diff at git's own line ends and abstains where its two readers still read a line apart (#205), and a declared count is ASCII digits in both ports (#206); every diffgate record names the build and runtime that wrote it, and charon's verifier names its own; the research capsule, the horizon datasheet, the robustness preregistration and its correction, the real-model bridge's closure, the zoo screen and the sealed-ahead records; and what else merged on main after 7.49.0. Upgrade with pip install -U styxx==7.50.0. The PyPI summary changes with this release: the April positioning ("Cognitive observability", "HaluEval-QA AUC 0.998") is replaced by what the instruments do; earlier PyPI pages are superseded, not edited. This record's keywords are pyproject.toml's at the tag, which the cut changed with the summary: 12 keywords where 7.49.0's record carries 15.

The list after this paragraph gives the heading of each of the 17 entries of the ## [7.50.0] section of CHANGELOG.md in this tree, where the full entries and their receipts are; each heading is as that section prints it, its markdown backticks dropped. The list of stale or wrong lines after them comes from that section and the ## [7.49.0] and ## [7.48.1] sections, from zenodo/MANIFEST.json (its open defects and its entry for this concept), from 7.49.0's record as committed under release/, and from the files each line names, as they stand at the tag. The last two sections describe this deposit: what it holds, and each file's size, sha256 and md5, computed from the deposited bytes, with the source bundle's file count taken from the tag's tree.

What this release carries: the 17 entries of the ## [7.50.0] section

  • conformance/sworn regenerated for 7.50.0: the version stamp moves every vector's id and no expected outcome
  • the front door says, in EXTERNAL-1's committed words, that the gate claim is not yet true, and stops making it
  • sealed-ahead: the build stopped on 2026-10-12; its battery, sizing week and stranger pool check are committed as records
  • diffgate cuts a diff where git does and abstains where its two readers still read a line apart (#205); a declared count is ASCII digits in both ports (#206)
  • the zoo D0 screen: 13 cached models on bridge v3's compare and recall at 16 tokens (pilot-class, licenses nothing)
  • charon's verifier names its runtime: verifier scheme styxx.charon/verifier/v1, module shas over LF bytes and the runtime inside the digest (identity phase 3)
  • a diffgate record names the build and runtime that wrote it: build and runtime after the eleven content keys (identity phase 2)
  • the real-model bridge, attempt three: NOT STARTED, two pilots both NEITHER, the behavioural route closed
  • PREREG: the permuted-MNIST headline under held-out permutations, new seeds and a 3x budget, sealed as a git blob before any run, with a CORRECTION sealed beside it before any data
  • the research capsule, Phase A: one HTML file carries the chain of one preregistered experiment and prints three readings per link
  • capsule v0.2 layer 2 compares a record's instrument identity apart from its content; styxx.instrument names the build and runtime a diffgate record is written and re-run under
  • styxx.horizon: the horizon datasheet, an instrument from per-item bits to censored horizons, with the self-test that gates its printing
  • capsule verify ends every hostile capsule in a named problem, never a traceback, and refuses the same file names on every system (#196)
  • the GitLab job reports by default; blocking is opt-in with STYXX_SOFT_FAIL: "false"
  • the leaderboard styxx leaderboard prints says what Baseline-019 measured, without the priority claim critique.py withdrew
  • NOTE: the HANDOFF capsule reproduces under its minting build; a record that names no build cannot say so
  • styxx 7.49.0 on Zenodo, as the next version of the software record

Known stale or wrong lines in the deposited tree

  • CITATION.cff gives version 7.49.0 and date-released 2026-10-07; the cut did not move them, and styxx/_version.py at the tag is 7.50.0. Its identifiers entry still names 7.48.0's version DOI (10.5281/zenodo.23042251) beside the concept DOI, which the Zenodo entry of the ## [7.50.0] section records as true of 7.48.0 and leaves to the operator.
  • README.md, which becomes the PyPI page, keeps its 91 tag-pinned links at v7.49.0; the cut did not move them to v7.50.0 (7.49.0's cut had moved its 89 from v7.48.0, as the ## [7.49.0] section records).
  • web/gate/README.md's opening paragraph calls the PATH-2a block not yet released, and its drift section, web/gate/differential/py_side.py and the headers of web/gate/diffgate.js and web/gate/bookmarklet_src.js still speak of 7.48.0 as not yet shipped. The bookmarklet's panel text (web/gate/bookmarklet_ui.js) still calls its port the 7.48.0 one, as web/gate/README.md says; that file's PATH-2a section says 7.49.0 released it.
  • The header comment of .github/workflows/diffgate.yml says the instrument is the released package; the Action imports the styxx package beside its script, at the ref the workflow names (the Action entry of the ## [7.49.0] section).
  • sworn/README.md and sworn/action.yml still give styxx==7.48.0 as the way to install the released styxx.sworn; GHSA-h5xv-4344-f62r (the ## [7.48.1] section) and GHSA-3g8h-qcfm-25xw (the ## [7.49.0] section) both name 7.48.0 as affected.
  • README.md labels 10.5281/zenodo.19326174, the concept record of the Fathom research-paper series, as the always-latest DOI in its badge row and link table (open defects D3 and D4 in zenodo/MANIFEST.json). Its citation row names the software concept DOI, 10.5281/zenodo.19758618.
  • CITATION.cff names the software concept DOI, but GitHub's "Cite this repository" prompt renders its preferred-citation, the position paper 10.5281/zenodo.19777921, which predates that paper's 2026-06-21 scope erratum (D2 in zenodo/MANIFEST.json). Whether the prompt should cite the software is left to the maintainer.
  • The committed EXTERNAL-1 packet, papers/closed-model-frontier/external1_packet.json, still carries the id leak. Since #125 its builder, external1_packet.py, numbers items by their shuffled position by default, and its build --as-published mode writes the pre-repair numbering on purpose, leak included, because the committed packet, key and digest are receipts; that mode has been shown only on a synthetic ledger and shelf, not run on the real ones. Whether any adjudicator used the leak cannot be re-tested.
  • zenodo/README.md still describes the 7.48.0 deposit flow only.
  • zenodo/MANIFEST.json names 7.49.0 (10.5281/zenodo.23221755) as the latest version of this concept; this record supersedes that line.
  • The ## [7.49.0] section, kept as released, carries the wording its record (10.5281/zenodo.23221755) lists as stale: that PATH-2a is not released, the styxx/diffgate.py digests #201 had moved, and the G-P1 decision left to the operator. Of the files that record names, styxx/_data/LEADERBOARD.md and the two comments in styxx/__init__.py no longer carry the Baseline-019 priority claim (the leaderboard entry above); the other lines stand as listed here.
  • papers/frequency-resonance/NOTE_zoo_d0_screen_plan_2026_10_12.md, section 15, says the partial log and the earlier attempt's zoo_d0_screen_refusal.json stay on disk, untracked; both files (zoo_d0_screen.partial.jsonl and zoo_d0_screen_refusal.json) are committed beside it, and the zoo entry says so.

Not in this deposit

This record holds the tagged tree and the two files PyPI serves for 7.50.0, and nothing else. Work merged to the default branch after the tag is not in it.

Files in this record

  • styxx-v7.50.0-source-bundle.zip: the source tree at tag v7.50.0: git archive --format=zip --prefix=styxx-7.50.0/ v7.50.0 run with core.autocrlf=false, so each of its 6164 files is byte-identical to its git blob (checked by blob id); the zip comment carries the commit id. 277268802 bytes; sha256 8f444bd13b035f00fb22c24c43109591b8a6fdde2d0b0002f5de25c7d0a25d6f; md5 37ce89258987104eb06ba1556b7e4b33
  • styxx-7.50.0-py3-none-any.whl: the wheel, as published on PyPI (sha256 checked against PyPI). 8208487 bytes; sha256 66744ee588eacfa413fe036b37fc4f7b171d15a86d2c0c31ceacf6f24a0560b3; md5 13d709d1c1419a8ad60fc7520f22ebd3
  • styxx-7.50.0.tar.gz: the sdist, as published on PyPI (sha256 checked against PyPI). 9041414 bytes; sha256 5f706fe0ba580e56155c37d4ca04f988ca14a87288189655ac6145871f1b7af5; md5 9192f9a80ecaa7f7ed8ee082b96b1ae6

Each file in the wheel outside its .dist-info directory, and each file in the sdist other than the build metadata its build generates (PKG-INFO, setup.cfg and styxx.egg-info/), is byte-identical to the tag's blob at the same path. .github/workflows/publish.yml at the tag uploads with attestations: false, so check the wheel and the sdist by the SHA-256 sums above, as SECURITY.md says.

Reproduce the source bundle's contents from a clone: git -c core.autocrlf=false archive --format=zip --prefix=styxx-7.50.0/ v7.50.0. Every file it holds then equals its git blob; the zip's own sha256 can differ with the git and zlib versions that write it. Without core.autocrlf=false on a machine that sets it, git converts text files to CRLF inside the archive and the file contents differ.
